body.title: 2 Year Anniversary Service, October 25
body.body: Join us as we celebrate Home Church turning two and give thanks for all the Lord has done. This Sunday, October 25, we will have our regular service times at 8:00am, 9:30am, and 11:00am. Bring a friend to celebrate with us. Free Baker's Dozens donuts will be available at all services, and Grounded Matcha & Vanilla House Cafe will be available for purchase.
